result.response:
Implemented type-safe window function helpers, frame specifications, and named `WINDOW` clause support across all supported dialects.

### Summary of Changes

- **Window Functions & Frame Helpers ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts))**:
  - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L238-L240), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L242-L244), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L246-L248), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L250-L253), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L255-L257), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L259-L261).
